caption: The drawing displays two views of a rectangular, gold-framed, ornamental object with slightly beveled corners. The upper view shows the front surface, which features a central design composed of a symmetrical arrangement of thread or cord forming a floral or bow-like motif. Surrounding this central motif is a border made up of golden leaves and small clusters of round forms, all set against a rich brown or reddish-brown background. The frame of the object is gold and has an angular, faceted shape with a small notch at the top, suggesting a clasp or hinge. The lower view depicts the object from the side, showing its thickness, the gold clasp mechanism, and the continuation of the brown and gold design around the edge. Both the frame and the decorative elements are rendered in shades of gold, contrasting with the dark backdrop. The illustration is set on a plain, cream-colored background with a small inscription in the lower right corner.
title: Gold Purse
